acceptanceCriteria: JT-AC-033: initial level, headphone and extreme-pitch warnings, duration reminders, SPL boundaries, and system protections satisfy hearing-safety requirements.

JT-TEST-148 through JT-TEST-161 cover truthful safe-level claims, system protection interaction, warning behavior, duration reminder behavior, unannounced attenuation, warned route restart, unsupported decibel claims, stereo balance, safety content, warning accessibility, physical safety matrix, and copy review.
The product never calls an output percentage, volume position, peak, or uncalibrated estimate safe, and never counteracts Apple hearing protections.
notes: Planning complete for the hearing-safety portion of SP-015. Any changed warning threshold, copy, or protection behavior requires direct requirement evidence and an Issue if the approved behavior is violated.
Physical-device route, headphone, system-protection, listening, endurance, and warning-acknowledgement observations remain human/device evidence; no simulator result may substitute for them.
rationale: Hearing-safety communication and system-protection respect are release-critical and require careful physical-device qualification.
testSteps: Run JT-TEST-148 through JT-TEST-161 except JT-TEST-152, which is not assigned to EP-007. Record warnings, cancellation and acknowledgement paths, route changes, system protection behavior, and resulting stopped or explicit-restart state.
Inspect all safety information and localization for conservative language, professional-advice boundaries, accessible labels, and absence of unsupported SPL or exposure claims.

Record device model, OS, route, headphone/system-protection state, configured level, pitch, duration, exact steps, observed outcome, and evidence source; keep device/listening results distinct from automated and simulator results.

workItem.title: Qualify hearing safeguards and safety communication
